description: Two signatures short of legal, someone needs a warm body to swear they saw a thing they didn't. Stand as witness at Halcyon Boulevard, then again at Voss Avenue. Nod when nodded at. 25₵.
name: Rent-a-Witness

emotes: {who} stands very still at a Halcyon Boulevard counter and solemnly attests to something never explained.
{who} makes a mark on a form beside a name they can't pronounce and won't remember.
{who} raises a hand to swear an oath, unsure what to, and swears to it anyway.
{who} loiters at a Voss Avenue window, ready to have 'definitely seen' whatever's required.
{who} signs a second witness line, blows on the ink, and pretends this is all above board.
{who} nods gravely at a clerk, having witnessed nothing, and pockets the stub.
